name: OSA — Verification Partner (JV)
_note: OSA is a JOINT VENTURE between ClearSky, SUN Energy Solutions and OGI Solar. orgId is 'osa' and is NOT an email domain, deliberately — nobody signs in as OSA. The three member firms sign in on their own domains and reach OSA-stamped records through an org_members grant, which canActInOrg() honours. demo-clearsky is the existing precedent for a non-domain orgId. This replaces the earlier note saying to leave orgId empty until the JV agreement fixed a sign-in domain: that assumed orgId had to BE a sign-in domain, and for a shared workspace it does not — it is an addressing key and access comes from the grants. Referrals sent to 'osa' are filed as intake_projects, which the OSA console already ingests; the referrals collection cannot serve a JV because its read rule compares toOrgId against the reader's own email domain and OSA has three. REQUIRES org_members rows for each JV member before they can see anything.
